scoring_justification: Checker independently computes the exact magnetization values using the same parameters and exact enumeration; each submitted point is compared within an absolute tolerance of 0.05.

outputs.description: Normalized magnetization (M/M_sat) as a function of temperature (2–30 K in 1 K steps) and applied magnetic field (200, 500, 1000 Oe) for an 8-cluster square-planar array with antiferromagnetic J₁₂ and DMI, computed via exact enumeration of 5⁸ spin configurations.

output_contract.notes: The checker independently recomputes the magnetization for the same model parameters and exact enumeration, then compares the submitted points within a hidden tolerance. The output must contain exactly one row for each (Temperature, Field) combination in the described ranges.
